scenes.a: If a terrifying report about your health has left you fearing the worst tonight, listen.
God promises in his holy word, I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD.
Lord Jesus, reach into this weary body right now and breathe your living power into every cell.
Command all illness to depart and drive away every shadow of fear and despair.
Where physical strength has failed, pour out your tender breath of resurrection life.
Subscribe to The Healing Balm to rest daily in God's healing peace.
